crossRefs.note: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the…
For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses…
and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’ ”
The high priest stood up, and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
“We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made…
The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
